pages.text: 晚饭后，Tina妈妈把咘咘抱在腿上，轻轻说：“宝贝，我们要回深圳了。”咘咘歪着头问：“回深圳？那幼儿园呢？那艳艳老师呢？”
pages.text_en: After dinner, Mama Tina held Bubu on her lap and said softly: "Sweetheart, we're moving back to Shenzhen." Bubu tilted her head: "Back to Shenzhen? What about kindergarten? What about Teacher Yanyan?"

pages.text: 咘咘的眼圈红了。Tina妈妈把她搂紧：“我知道你舍不得，妈妈也舍不得。但是深圳也有很棒的幼儿园，会有新老师、新朋友。”Sam爸爸蹲下来，摸摸咘咘的头：“而且Oliver在深圳等你呢。”咘咘吸了吸鼻子，小声说：“那我可以跟大家好好说再见吗？”
pages.text_en: Bubu's eyes turned red. Mama Tina hugged her tight: "I know you'll miss everyone, Mama will too. But Shenzhen has wonderful kindergartens too, with new teachers and new friends." Papa Sam knelt down and patted her head: "And Oliver is waiting for you in Shenzhen." Bubu sniffled and whispered: "Can I say goodbye to everyone properly?"

pages.text: 星期一早上，咘咘穿上她最喜欢的粉红色裙子，背上小书包。“今天是我在苏州幼儿园的最后一天。”她站在幼儿园门口，看了好久好久。阳光照在滑梯上，风吹过她摸过一千次的栅栏。
pages.text_en: Monday morning, Bubu put on her favorite pink dress and her little backpack. "Today is my last day at kindergarten in Suzhou." She stood at the kindergarten gate and looked at it for a long, long time. Sunlight fell on the slide, and the wind blew past the fence she had touched a thousand times.

pages.text: 走进教室，一切都好熟悉——墙上贴着小朋友们画的画，角落里的积木城堡还是上周搭的，窗台上的小花开了新的花苞。咘咘用手指轻轻碰了碰每一样东西，想把它们都记住。
pages.text_en: Walking into the classroom, everything felt so familiar — the children's drawings on the wall, the block castle in the corner still standing from last week, new flower buds blooming on the windowsill. Bubu gently touched each thing with her finger, trying to remember them all.

pages.text: 艳艳老师走过来，蹲下身子抱住咘咘：“老师好舍不得你啊。”咘咘搂着老师的脖子：“艳艳老师，你还记得我第一天来的时候吗？我哭了好久好久。”艳艳老师笑了：“当然记得。后来是菲菲把自己的小饼干分给你，你才笑了。”
pages.text_en: Teacher Yanyan walked over, knelt down, and hugged Bubu: "I'm going to miss you so much." Bubu wrapped her arms around her neck: "Teacher Yanyan, do you remember my first day? I cried for so long." Teacher Yanyan smiled: "Of course. Then Feifei shared her cookies with you, and you finally smiled."

pages.text: 咘咘也笑了，眼泪却掉了下来：“谢谢老师一直对我那么好。”艳艳老师帮咘咘擦掉眼泪，鼻子碰鼻子：“你永远是老师最喜欢的小白兔。到了深圳，也要好好吃饭、好好睡觉哦。”
pages.text_en: Bubu smiled too, but tears rolled down her cheeks: "Thank you for always being so kind to me." Teacher Yanyan wiped her tears and touched her nose to Bubu's: "You'll always be my favorite little white bunny. Eat well and sleep well in Shenzhen, okay?"

pages.text: 张老师走过来，眼睛红红的。她拉着咘咘的手，两人一起唱起那首最爱的儿歌。唱着唱着，咘咘把头靠在张老师的肩膀上。“张老师，你的声音最好听了，我到深圳也会唱给新朋友听的。”
pages.text_en: Teacher Zhang came over, her eyes a little red. She held Bubu's hand, and they sang their favorite nursery rhyme together. As they sang, Bubu leaned her head on Teacher Zhang's shoulder. "Teacher Zhang, you have the prettiest voice. I'll sing for my new friends in Shenzhen too."

pages.text: 菲菲和莫瑜跑过来，一左一右抱住咘咘。菲菲小声说：“你走了，谁跟我一起荡秋千呀？”咘咘拉着菲菲的手：“你还有莫瑜呀！而且我们可以让妈妈帮我们打电话！”她伸出小拇指：“拉钩，一百年不许变！”
pages.text_en: Feifei and Moyu ran over, hugging Bubu from both sides. Feifei whispered: "When you leave, who will swing with me?" Bubu held Feifei's hand: "You still have Moyu! And our moms can help us call each other!" She stuck out her pinky: "Pinky promise, never ever break it!"

pages.text: 放学前，小朋友们围着咘咘，把一张大大的卡片递给她。上面画满了歪歪扭扭的画——一起玩滑梯、一起吃午饭，角落里还有莫瑜画的一只胖胖的小狗。大家围成一个圈，把咘咘抱在中间。老师们也加入了。“我们永远是好朋友！”所有人一起喊。
pages.text_en: Before school ended, the children gathered around Bubu and handed her a big card. It was covered with wobbly drawings — playing on the slide, eating lunch together, and a chubby little dog drawn by Moyu. Everyone formed a circle and hugged Bubu in the middle. The teachers joined in too. "We'll be friends forever!" everyone cheered.

pages.text: 第二天，Sam爸爸开车去机场。咘咘趴在车窗上，看着苏州的房子、树和河一点一点变小。“再见了，苏州。”她轻轻说。NOMI坐在旁边，悄悄握了握咘咘的手。
pages.text_en: The next day, Papa Sam drove to the airport. Bubu pressed her face against the car window, watching the houses, trees, and rivers of Suzhou grow smaller and smaller. "Goodbye, Suzhou," she whispered. NOMI sat beside her and quietly held her hand.

pages.text: 到深圳了！回家的路上，Tina妈妈指着路边一个幼儿园说：“看，那就是你的新幼儿园。”透过栅栏，咘咘看见好大的滑梯、漂亮的沙坑，还有小朋友在草地上追泡泡。“妈妈，好大呀！”
pages.text_en: They arrived in Shenzhen! On the way home, Mama Tina pointed to a kindergarten by the road: "Look, that's your new kindergarten." Through the fence, Bubu saw a huge slide, a pretty sandbox, and children chasing bubbles on the grass. "Mama, it's so big!"

pages.text: 可是到了上学的那天早上，咘咘站在新幼儿园门口，脚像被胶水粘住了一样走不动。这里的大门不一样，教室不一样，连滑梯的颜色都不一样。“妈妈，我不想进去……”她紧紧拽着Tina妈妈的手。
pages.text_en: But on the first morning of school, Bubu stood at the new kindergarten gate and her feet wouldn't move, as if glued to the ground. The door was different, the classroom was different, even the slide was a different color. "Mama, I don't want to go in..." She gripped Mama Tina's hand tightly.

pages.text: 一位笑眯眯的鹿老师走了出来，蹲下来温柔地说：“你就是咘咘吧？我是李老师，我等你好久啦！”她伸出她纤细的手，轻轻拉了拉咘咘的手。咘咘小心翼翼地跟着她走进了教室。
pages.text_en: A smiling deer teacher came out, knelt down and said gently: "You must be Bubu! I'm Teacher Li. I've been waiting for you!" She reached out her slender hand and gently took Bubu's hand. Bubu cautiously followed her into the classroom.

pages.text: 教室里，一只小水獭举着蜡笔朝咘咘挥手：“你好！你要一起画画吗？我叫乐乐！”咘咘愣了一下，乐乐已经把一支粉色蜡笔递到她面前。她接过蜡笔，小声说：“好……好呀。”
pages.text_en: In the classroom, a little otter waved a crayon at Bubu: "Hi! Want to draw with me? I'm Lele!" Bubu blinked in surprise. Lele had already handed her a pink crayon. She took it and said quietly: "O...okay."

pages.text: 画着画着，咘咘发现这个教室也有好玩的东西——巨大的积木区、一整面墙的绘本架、还有一个小小的种植角，里面种着向日葵小苗。“哇，这里有向日葵！”咘咘的眼睛亮了起来。李老师笑着说：“那以后你来照顾它们好不好？”
pages.text_en: As they drew together, Bubu noticed the classroom had fun things too — a giant building block area, a whole wall of bookshelves, and a little gardening corner with sunflower seedlings. "Wow, there are sunflowers!" Bubu's eyes lit up. Teacher Li smiled: "Would you like to take care of them?"

pages.text: 户外活动时间，乐乐拉着咘咘的手去荡秋千。秋千荡得高高的，风吹过咘咘的耳朵，和苏州幼儿园的风一样温柔。下了秋千，乐乐笑着说：“明天我们一起玩沙子吧！”咘咘用力点头：“好！”
pages.text_en: During outdoor playtime, Lele pulled Bubu by the hand to the swings. The swing flew high, and the wind brushed Bubu's ears — just as gentle as the wind at her Suzhou kindergarten. When she hopped off, Lele grinned: "Let's play in the sandbox tomorrow!" Bubu nodded eagerly: "Yes!"

pages.text: 晚上，咘咘躺在深圳家的小床上。Oliver趴在床边，尾巴轻轻摇着。NOMI坐在枕头旁边，NONO在床头灯上打着小呼噜。咘咘看着天花板上的星星夜灯，轻轻说：“苏州的朋友们，晚安。我今天交到新朋友了哦，她叫乐乐。明天我还要去幼儿园呢。”说完，她笑着闭上眼睛，甜甜地睡着了。
pages.text_en: That night, Bubu lay in her little bed at their Shenzhen home. Oliver rested by the bedside, his tail wagging softly. NOMI sat by her pillow, and NONO dozed on the bedside lamp. Bubu looked at the star-shaped night light and whispered: "Goodnight, friends in Suzhou. I made a new friend today — her name is Lele. I'm going back to kindergarten tomorrow." Then she smiled, closed her eyes, and fell sweetly asleep.
